steps.title: Nia Park: internship learning portfolio · part 1
steps.detail: Nia Park asks for an internship learning portfolio. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Nia Park: internship learning portfolio · part 2
steps.detail: The internship learning portfolio now has conflicting notes. Nia Park wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain

steps.title: Nia Park: internship learning portfolio · part 3
steps.detail: Nia Park is ready to introduce a paying client for the internship learning portfolio. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented internship learning portfolio. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Nia Park.
